Top visible variants include V39L;D40Y, V39I;D40Y, V39L;D40Y;V54C, D40Y;V54C, and V39L;D40W;V54C. Non-feature constraints favor preserving the buried V54 pocket and measuring combinations rather than assuming additivity. This inference is a directional prior requiring combinatorial testing, not an additive claim.
